mainEntity.name: What is advanced or functional lab testing?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is expanded blood and specialty testing, read against functional ranges, the narrower windows where symptoms begin rather than the wide ranges used only to diagnose disease. That catches problems a standard checkup often calls “normal.”

mainEntity.name: Why were my labs “normal” when I feel awful?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard ranges are very wide and built to flag disease, not early dysfunction. We use functional ranges and order the markers a basic panel skips, then read everything together against your symptoms.

mainEntity.name: What do you test that my regular doctor does not?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depending on your symptoms, that can include expanded thyroid, nutrient, metabolic, inflammatory, and specialty markers, plus hormone or gut testing where relevant. We order what answers your specific questions, not a fixed list.

mainEntity.name: Is advanced lab testing worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is worth it when your symptoms are real and the results will change your plan. Ordered for the right reason and interpreted by a clinician, it can pinpoint a root cause early; run randomly with no one reading it, it is just numbers.

mainEntity.name: Can I just order labs online myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can, but you are then left to interpret a wall of markers alone. Here labs are ordered off your symptoms and read by a physician who turns them into an actual plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I just get the testing without becoming a patient?

acceptedAnswer.text: Testing here is always part of physician-led care. You start with a $99 Symptom Consultation so labs are ordered for the right reason and the results are actually used.

sections.label: Hero

headings.text: Advanced lab testing in Atlanta, read for root cause and built into your plan.

paragraphs: If your labs keep coming back “normal” while you clearly do not feel normal, the problem was never your imagination. It is that a basic panel with broad ranges was never built to catch what is actually off.

I am Dr. Nina Ross, ND PhD. Advanced testing here means we order the right expanded panels and I read them against functional ranges, as one move inside a plan that treats what they reveal. That is how you get past “everything is fine” to a real answer.

sections.label: What it is

headings.text: The markers a basic panel skips, read against ranges that catch problems early.

paragraphs: Advanced testing goes past the standard panel, expanded thyroid, metabolic, nutrient, inflammatory, and specialty markers, interpreted against functional ranges. That depth is real and genuinely useful, and it pays off when a clinician reads it against your symptoms and turns it into a plan.
We order the expanded and specialty markers a standard checkup never includes.
We read your results against the narrower ranges where symptoms begin, not just disease cutoffs.
Dr. Nina interprets it against your symptoms and history, so the whole picture comes together.

sections.label: Who it's for

headings.text: Advanced testing is right for some people. It is wrong for others.

eyebrowSpans: It is not for you if
paragraphs: If that second list stung a little, good. That honesty is exactly what you are paying for here.

boldPairs.body: Your standard labs are “normal” but your symptoms clearly are not
You want to find the root cause early, before it becomes a diagnosis
You want a clinician to connect the markers into a plan you can act on

boldPairs.title: It is not for you if

boldPairs.body: You want a pile of numbers with no interest in what to do about them
You are hoping a test alone will fix something a test can only measure
You expect one panel to replace an ongoing relationship with a clinician

sections.label: Not a lab-on-demand

headings.text: Anyone can sell you a panel now. Reading it for root cause is the hard part.

paragraphs: Order labs online and you get a wall of markers, a few red flags, and no one to call. No one connecting the values to your symptoms, no plan when the results land. Here, advanced testing is ordered for a reason and interpreted by a physician, as one tool inside a plan that acts on what it finds.

boldPairs.title: Ordered for a reason, not a whim
boldPairs.body: We test because your symptoms point somewhere, so the results actually answer a question.

boldPairs.title: Interpreted, not just delivered
boldPairs.body: The values are the start; what they mean together for you is where the real work is.

boldPairs.title: A physician reading it, not an algorithm
boldPairs.body: Reviewed against your whole history by a doctor, then turned into next steps.
